override.discovery: Before diagnosing or redesigning existing behavior, run continuity_history_search with focused terms. History is prior intent; verify it against code. Skip for mechanical edits.
override.task-identity: Checkpoint only under your own task_id. To review another agent's task, use a new task_id with reviews_task_id.
override.resume-completion: On resume, first check whether the remaining action is already done. If it is, verify it and save the task completed. A restart alone is not completion.
override.checkout-lifecycle: Work in the current checkout and branch. Create a branch or worktree only for a confirmed concurrent writer, explicit isolation, or a required workflow; open tasks, branches and presence do not prove one. After integration, remove only clean task worktrees and branches with no unique commits.
